info.name: Assignment01 - Task12 final extensions (one percent fee)
info.description: Nimsara, EC/2022/052, BECS32263. Run in listed order ONCE against fresh independent seed data with bank.transfer.fee-rate=0.01. Proves fee conservation, rollback, deposits/withdrawals, strict large-transfer threshold and successful principal/fee aggregates. Final expected total85300, principal sent25001, fees250.01.

item.name: 07 - Large transfers filter is strictly greater than10000

exec: const expected = {'Total balance (LKR)': total, 'Successful transfers': successful, 'Failed transfers': failed};

const resultRows=records(); pm.test('Exactly one large successful transfer', () => pm.expect(resultRows.length).to.equal(1)); pm.test('10001 principal is included', () => pm.expect(resultRows.some(row => row.includes('10,001.00'))).to.equal(true)); pm.test('Exact10000 transfer is excluded', () => pm.expect(resultRows.some(row => row.includes('10,000.00'))).to.equal(false)); pm.test('Only successful records displayed', () => pm.expect(resultRows.every(row => row.includes('SUCCESS') && !row.includes('FAILED'))).to.equal(true));

item.name: 08 - History sums principal and fees without cash or failure

historyAmounts(25001,250.01); pm.test('History includes three transfers, one failure and two cash operations', () => pm.expect(records().length).to.equal(6)); message('Cash deposit completed'); message('Cash withdrawal completed'); message('FAILED');
